text: ① 15:00 德国10月CPI终值； ② 15:50 欧洲央行执委会成员Piero Cipollone通过线上方式参与数字欧元圆桌会议； ③ 16:10 欧洲央行管委Kazaks讲话； ④ 16:15 欧洲央行管委兼德国央行行长Nagel谈论德国经济和欧洲未来所面临的挑战； ⑤ 17:45 欧洲央行行长拉加德参与第九届巴黎和平论坛； ⑥ 时间待定 石油输出国组织（OPEC，欧佩克）公布月度原油市场报告； 微信小程序搜索“见闻历”，了解更多。
text_en: ① 15:00 Germany October CPI final; ② 15:50 ECB Executive Board member Piero Cipollone participates online in a digital euro roundtable; ③ 16:10 ECB Governing Council member Kazaks speaks; ④ 16:15 ECB Governing Council member and Bundesbank President Nagel discusses the challenges facing the German economy and Europe's future; ⑤ 17:45 ECB President Lagarde participates in the ninth Paris Peace Forum; ⑥ Time TBD OPEC publishes its monthly oil market report; Search "见闻历" on WeChat Mini Programs to learn more.
